questions.q: What is AO2 in Cambridge IGCSE Art & Design?
options: Explore and select appropriate resources, media, materials, techniques and processes
Present a personal and coherent response
questions.why: AO2 Explore: explore and select appropriate resources, media, materials, techniques and processes.

questions.q: Why should a failed experiment be kept in your sketchbook?
options: Examiners only mark the final piece
With a note on why it failed it shows reflection and refinement
questions.why: The syllabus lists 'reflect, refine and adapt'; annotated failures show this.

options: A small preliminary model of a 3D design
questions.why: Maquettes test form and structure before the final piece.

questions.q: Describe how you would experiment to show the texture of old walls.
questions.model: Try wax resist with ink wash, scraped acrylic and torn paper collage, label each, and select the one that best matches the texture, saying why.
